title: OEDS Grid Frequency
description: German grid frequency in Hz, 1 second resolution, 2011 to 2019-08 (TransnetBW archive).

panels.title: frequency.frequency
panels.description: First and latest timestamp and approximate number of 1 s samples. The source archive ends in 2019-08, so there is no live data. Large time ranges are slow: 253 million rows, keep the range to a few weeks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(epoch from min(index))*1000)::bigint as "First", (extract(epoch from max(index))*1000)::bigint as "Latest", approximate_row_count('frequency.frequency'::regclass) as "Rows (approx.)"
FROM frequency.frequency

panels.title: Selected range: statistics
panels.description: Statistics of the valid samples in the selected range. Nominal frequency is 50 Hz, the normal band is +-50 mHz, +-200 mHz is the limit of the normal operation range (ENTSO-E).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(frequency) AS "Mean", stddev(frequency)*1000 AS "Std. dev.", min(frequency) AS "Min", max(frequency) AS "Max", 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(frequency-50) > 0.05)/count(*) AS "Outside +-50 mHz", 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(frequency-50) > 0.2)/count(*) AS "Outside +-200 mHz"
FROM frequency.frequency WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51

panels.title: Grid frequency (min / mean / max per bin)
panels.description: Minimum, mean and maximum of the 1 s values per time bin. The dashed lines mark the +-200 mHz limit. The raw data contains sentinel values (0 Hz for missing readings, 48 Hz and 52 Hz as limits, e.g. a constant 48 Hz in 2015-04 to 2015-06). Panels use only values between 49 and 51 Hz. Early 2011 data has 4 s resolution.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), min(frequency) AS "Min", avg(frequency) AS "Mean", max(frequency) AS "Max"
FROM frequency.frequency WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Frequency histogram
panels.description: Number of seconds per 5 mHz class between 49.8 and 50.2 Hz (the first and last class contain everything beyond). The distribution is close to normal around 50.00 Hz.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(49.8 + (greatest(least(width_bucket(frequency, 49.8, 50.2, 80), 80), 1) - 0.5) * 0.005, 'FM00.000') AS "Frequency (Hz)", count(*) AS "Seconds"
FROM frequency.frequency WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Share of time outside the band per day
panels.description: Share of seconds per day with |f - 50 Hz| above 50 mHz, 100 mHz and 200 mHz.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(index,'1d'), 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(frequency-50) > 0.05)/count(*) AS "> 50 mHz", 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(frequency-50) > 0.1)/count(*) AS "> 100 mHz", 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(frequency-50) > 0.2)/count(*) AS "> 200 mHz"
FROM frequency.frequency WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily standard deviation
panels.description: Standard deviation of the frequency per day in mHz: a measure of how volatile the balance between generation and load was.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(index,'1d'), stddev(frequency)*1000 AS "Std. dev.", min(frequency) AS "Daily min (Hz)", max(frequency) AS "Daily max (Hz)" FROM frequency.frequency WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Largest excursions
panels.description: The 10 lowest and 10 highest valid 1 s values in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
(SELECT (extract(epoch from index)*1000)::bigint AS "Time", frequency AS "Frequency" FROM frequency.frequency WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51 ORDER BY frequency ASC LIMIT 10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT (extract(epoch from index)*1000)::bigint, frequency FROM frequency.frequency WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51 ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 10)
ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Mean deviation by minute of the day
panels.description: Mean frequency deviation from 50 Hz (mHz) for each minute of the local day (Europe/Berlin) in the selected range. Typical saw tooth: deviations build up around the full hour when market schedules of power plants change in steps while the load changes smoothly.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(hour from index AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')*60 + extract(minute from index AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'))::int AS "Minute of day", (avg(frequency)-50)*1000 AS "Mean deviation (mHz)" FROM frequency.frequency
WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Volatility by hour of the day
panels.description: Standard deviation (mHz) and mean absolute deviation (mHz) of the frequency by local hour. Larger values around the morning and evening ramps.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(hour from index AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::int AS "Hour", stddev(frequency)*1000 AS "Std. dev. (mHz)", avg(abs(frequency-50))*1000 AS "Mean abs. deviation (mHz)" FROM frequency.frequency
WHERE $__timeFilter(index) AND frequency BETWEEN 49 AND 51 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly volatility, sampled
panels.description: Standard deviation of the frequency (mHz) and share of time outside +-50 mHz, computed from a sample of 6 hours (00:00-06:00 UTC) on the 15th of every month over the whole archive 2011 to 2019, to stay fast on 253 million rows. Independent of the time range. Months with constant 48 Hz/0 Hz sentinels are excluded by the valid filter.
